prompt:
Create an AI Agent Library website for entrepreneurs, affiliates, creators, and small business owners. The library should showcase AI assistants for funding readiness, business credit, content creation, CRM parsing, client onboarding, lead generation, social media, referral outreach, and workflow automation.
Visual style: futuristic app marketplace with dark mode, glowing cards, category filters, agent profile cards, and premium SaaS aesthetics.
Strong hook: “AI Agents for Operators Who Want Leverage, Not More Tabs.”
Hero message: “Browse practical AI assistants built to help entrepreneurs generate leads, organize workflows, create content, qualify clients, and automate the boring business goblin work.”
CTA: “Browse AI Agents”
Sections needed:
- Hero section
- Search and category filters
- Agent card grid
- Featured agents
- Use case categories
- How to use the agents
- CTA to request a custom agent
- FAQ
- Final CTA
Generate static files with JavaScript filtering.
